text:
Platinum Price in 1993
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1993, the LBMA platinum price rose 8.0% between 1993-01-29 ($365) and 1993-12-30 ($394). The highest sampled price was $414 in July and the lowest was $345 in February. The mean of these observations was $378. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
